name: Tha. Muruganantham
bio: Tha. Muruganantham is a Director, Writer, Screenwriter, and Lyricist from India, has worked in in Tamil film industry.

credits.title: Irulil Ravanan
credits.overview: "Iruil Ravana" is a crime thriller film set in the land of Ravana."Iruil Ravana" is a crime thriller film set in the land of Ravana.

credits.title: Idhayam Murali
credits.overview: A young man navigates the complexities of unrequited love, finding that even as years pass and life takes unexpected turns, certain emotions remain deeply embedded in his heart.

credits.title: Keatta Vaarththai Ketta Vaarththai
credits.overview: Words are gifts in our lives… but when those very words turn into curses, they show us what life can become !!

credits.title: Kambi Katna Kathai
credits.overview: What happens when a smooth-talking thief decides to upgrade his hustle?  He cons his way to divinity! This hilarious satire follows a lovable rogue who scams his way through society, faces wild challenges, and somehow ends up a revered godman with his own private island. Welcome to a world where faith meets fraud—loudl

credits.title: Love Marriage
credits.overview: Ram, a 33-year-old Bachelor From Madurai, Faces Mounting Pressure to Get Married. Amidst Cultural Expectations and Comic Misadventures, He Embarks on a Journey of Self-discovery, Questioning Tradition and Seeking His Own Path to Happiness

credits.title: Tik Tok
credits.overview: Three friends starting a business are haunted by a ghost who wants to know his killer. They must solve the mystery to save their lives and their venture.

credits.title: Infinity
credits.overview: A series of murders happens in the city, involving a writer, a policeman, and a missing young woman, complicate things for the police department. A CBI officer takes up the case, hardly realising that he's about to unravel something more than he expected.

credits.title: Veeran
credits.overview: Kumaran has had a troubled childhood after getting hit by lightning, comes back to his village to fight evil elements and provide hope through indigenous deities.

credits.title: Deiva Machan
credits.overview: A youngster from a small town believes that his only responsibility in life is to find a suitable groom for his sister. However, when things fall into place, he is faced with an issue that he would have never expected in life.

credits.title: Kannai Nambathe
credits.overview: Arun finds himself caught up in a crime that he has no connection to whatsoever. Following his roommate's advice, he attempts to cover up the situation with cleverness. Will he be able to extricate himself from this predicament, or will he unwittingly reveal a much larger conspiracy than he ever anticipated?

credits.title: Manmatha Leelai
credits.overview: Two one-night stands in the life of a man that happen 10 years apart seem to mirror each other. Is there something more to them than what meets our eyes?

credits.title: Koorman
credits.overview: A former cop with mind-reading skills gets involved in a case involving rape and murder. Can he crack it while keeping a lid on the ghosts of his own past?

credits.title: Lift
credits.overview: A usual working day turns unusual for Guru and Harini when they get trapped in their haunted office. A patterned game unlocks a mystery and a lift is their only way out.

credits.title: Thirupathisamy Kudumbam
credits.overview: Thirupathisamy is the quintessential middle-class every man. He makes a living as a cab driver, and leads a happy life with his wife and three children. However, things are about to change forever for them following an unexpected incident.

credits.title: Katha Nayagan
credits.overview: A coward has to prove that he can be brave to marry the girl he is in love with.

credits.title: Maragadha Naanayam
credits.overview: Senguttuvan and Elango are hired by a jewel smuggler to find a cursed treasure responsible for the death of many. Later, with the help of a priest, they summon three spirits to locate the treasure.

credits.title: Kaashmora
credits.overview: Kaashmora, a present era black magic specialist; Rajnayak, an ancient era warlord and Ratnamahadevi is his queen. How these three are connected? What are the issues that arise?

credits.title: Maiem
credits.overview: Three people are trapped inside an ATM on the outskirts of the city with a stranger waiting outside to attack them. With no means to seek help, can they get out alive?
